title: Open Trestle Model Requirements v1
description: Canonical interchange shape for minimum model requirements. Validation does not prove that a route or model satisfies them.

required_features.description: Required optional model features. Array order has no meaning.

min_context_tokens.description: Minimum total context capacity. Zero imposes no context minimum.

min_output_tokens.description: Minimum output capacity. Zero imposes no output minimum.
